output.answer_markdown: Cummins said it manages commodity price risk by periodically entering into commodity swap and forward contracts to fix the cost of certain raw material purchases, aiming to limit changes in inventory cost and gross margin from market price moves [1]. At December 31, 2021, realized and unrealized gains and losses on these cash flow hedges were not material to its financial statements [2]. Separately, its platinum and palladium physical forward contracts had total commitments of $101 million at that date [3]. The material does not give quantified year-end hedging gains or losses, so that part of the question is not fully answered.

provenance.quote: In order to protect ourselves against future price volatility and, consequently, fluctuations in gross margins, we periodically enter into commodity swap and forward contracts with designated banks and other counterparties to fix the cost of certain raw material purchases with the objective of minimizing changes in inventory cost due to market price fluctuations.

claims.text: Cummins periodically enters into commodity swap and forward contracts to fix the cost of certain raw material purchases, to protect against price volatility and fluctuations in gross margins and to minimize changes in inventory cost.

provenance.quote: These commodity swaps are designated and qualify as cash flow hedges. At December 31, 2021, realized and unrealized gains and losses related to these hedges were not material to our financial statements.

claims.text: At December 31, 2021, realized and unrealized gains and losses related to Cummins' commodity cash flow hedges were not material to its financial statements.

provenance.quote: At December 31, 2021, the total commitments under these contracts were $101 million.

claims.text: Physical forward contracts for platinum and palladium had total commitments of $101 million at December 31, 2021.

found: Cummins uses commodity swap and forward contracts to fix raw material purchase costs.
Realized and unrealized gains and losses on the commodity cash flow hedges were not material at December 31, 2021.
Platinum and palladium physical forward contract commitments were $101 million at December 31, 2021.
missing: Quantified fair value or realized and unrealized gain or loss amounts on commodity hedges at December 31, 2021.
refusal.reason: The material gives no quantified year-end gains or losses on commodity hedges, only that they were not material.
